시편 119:1.content: א ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

시편 119:2.content: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

시편 119:3.content: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

시편 119:4.content: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

시편 119:5.content: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

시편 119:6.content: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

시편 119:7.content: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

시편 119:8.content: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

시편 119:9.content: ב BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

시편 119:10.content: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

시편 119:11.content: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

시편 119:12.content: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:13.content: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

시편 119:14.content: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

시편 119:15.content: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

시편 119:16.content: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

시편 119:17.content: ג GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

시편 119:18.content: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

시편 119:19.content: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

시편 119:20.content: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

시편 119:21.content: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

시편 119:22.content: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

시편 119:23.content: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

시편 119:24.content: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

시편 119:25.content: ד DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

시편 119:26.content: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:27.content: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

시편 119:28.content: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

시편 119:29.content: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

시편 119:30.content: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

시편 119:31.content: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

시편 119:32.content: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

시편 119:33.content: ה HE. Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

시편 119:34.content: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

시편 119:35.content: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

시편 119:36.content: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

시편 119:37.content: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

시편 119:38.content: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

시편 119:39.content: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

시편 119:40.content: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

시편 119:41.content: ו VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

시편 119:42.content: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

시편 119:43.content: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

시편 119:44.content: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

시편 119:45.content: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

시편 119:46.content: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

시편 119:47.content: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

시편 119:48.content: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

시편 119:49.content: ז ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

시편 119:50.content: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

시편 119:51.content: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

시편 119:52.content: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

시편 119:53.content: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

시편 119:54.content: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

시편 119:55.content: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

시편 119:56.content: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

시편 119:57.content: ח CHETH. Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

시편 119:58.content: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

시편 119:59.content: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

시편 119:60.content: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

시편 119:61.content: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

시편 119:62.content: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

시편 119:63.content: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

시편 119:64.content: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:65.content: ט TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

시편 119:66.content: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

시편 119:67.content: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

시편 119:68.content: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:69.content: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

시편 119:70.content: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

시편 119:71.content: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

시편 119:72.content: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

시편 119:73.content: י JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

시편 119:74.content: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

시편 119:75.content: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

시편 119:76.content: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

시편 119:77.content: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

시편 119:78.content: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

시편 119:79.content: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

시편 119:80.content: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

시편 119:81.content: כ CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

시편 119:82.content: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

시편 119:83.content: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

시편 119:84.content: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

시편 119:85.content: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

시편 119:86.content: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

시편 119:87.content: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

시편 119:88.content: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

시편 119:89.content: ל LAMED. For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

시편 119:90.content: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

시편 119:91.content: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

시편 119:92.content: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

시편 119:93.content: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

시편 119:94.content: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

시편 119:95.content: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

시편 119:96.content: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

시편 119:97.content: מ MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

시편 119:98.content: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

시편 119:99.content: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

시편 119:100.content: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

시편 119:101.content: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

시편 119:102.content: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

시편 119:103.content: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

시편 119:104.content: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

시편 119:105.content: נ NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

시편 119:106.content: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

시편 119:107.content: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

시편 119:108.content: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

시편 119:109.content: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

시편 119:110.content: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

시편 119:111.content: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

시편 119:112.content: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

시편 119:113.content: ס SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

시편 119:114.content: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

시편 119:115.content: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

시편 119:116.content: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

시편 119:117.content: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

시편 119:118.content: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

시편 119:119.content: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

시편 119:120.content: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

시편 119:121.content: ע AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

시편 119:122.content: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

시편 119:123.content: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

시편 119:124.content: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:125.content: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

시편 119:126.content: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

시편 119:127.content: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

시편 119:128.content: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

시편 119:129.content: פ PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

시편 119:130.content: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

시편 119:131.content: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

시편 119:132.content: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

시편 119:133.content: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

시편 119:134.content: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

시편 119:135.content: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

시편 119:136.content: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

시편 119:137.content: צ TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

시편 119:138.content: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

시편 119:139.content: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

시편 119:140.content: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

시편 119:141.content: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

시편 119:142.content: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

시편 119:143.content: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

시편 119:144.content: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

시편 119:145.content: ק KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

시편 119:146.content: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

시편 119:147.content: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

시편 119:148.content: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

시편 119:149.content: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

시편 119:150.content: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

시편 119:151.content: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

시편 119:152.content: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

시편 119:153.content: ר RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

시편 119:154.content: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

시편 119:155.content: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

시편 119:156.content: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

시편 119:157.content: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

시편 119:158.content: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

시편 119:159.content: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

시편 119:160.content: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

시편 119:161.content: ש SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

시편 119:162.content: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

시편 119:163.content: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

시편 119:164.content: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

시편 119:165.content: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

시편 119:166.content: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

시편 119:167.content: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

시편 119:168.content: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

시편 119:169.content: ת TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

시편 119:170.content: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

시편 119:171.content: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

시편 119:172.content: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

시편 119:173.content: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

시편 119:174.content: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

시편 119:175.content: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

시편 119:176.content: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
